name: Clear Font Cache
description: Clears the Windows font cache to fix missing fonts or broken text rendering caused by corrupted data. The system rebuilds this temporary file automatically after cleaning.

description_i18n.en: Clears the Windows font cache to fix missing fonts or broken text rendering caused by corrupted data. The system rebuilds this temporary file automatically after cleaning.
description_i18n.de: Leert den Windows-Schriftarten-Cache zur Behebung von fehlenden Schriftarten oder Textdarstellungsfehlern durch beschädigte Daten. Das System baut diese temporäre Datei nach der Reinigung automatisch neu auf.
description_i18n.fr: Vide le cache des polices de Windows pour corriger les problèmes d'affichage ou de texte causés par des données corrompues. Le système reconstruit ce fichier temporaire automatiquement après le nettoyage.

warnings.title: Temporary slowdown during rebuild
warnings.message: Windows may take longer to load fonts while the cache is rebuilt after cleanup. This action does not repair broken font files or reinstall missing fonts

warnings.title: Service state change
warnings.message: Related Windows services may stop or restart briefly while the action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Stops the FontCache and FontCache3.0.0.0 services, removes local font cache databases in ServiceProfiles\LocalService\AppData\Local and deletes FNTCACHE.DAT from System32
